{{Quote|Jump!|Aramis to Duchess Satine before his death|<ref name="dom" />}}
'''Aramis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Aramis was transporting Duchess Kryze from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when his [[ComfortRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] was sabotaged by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|trying]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kryze. Barely having any control over the damaged speeder, Aramis was able to fly close enough to a balcony so that the Duchess and [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|her guards]] were able to jump off the speeder before he crashed it into a building, resulting in his death.

==Biography==
{{Quote|What's going on?''"<br />"''It's the navigation system.|Satine and Aramis shortly before his death|<ref name="dom" />}}
[[File:AramisDies-DoM.png|thumb|left|250px|Aramis's speeder crashes into a building as the Duchess watches.]]
Aramis was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]].<ref name="dom" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWnovel" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Aramis was flying the Duchess and three of her [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|guards]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in a [[ComfortRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|ComfortRide passenger airspeeder]]. However, unbeknownst to Aramis, their speeder had been sabotaged by [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group from [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|trying]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kryze so that they could take over the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. As Aramis's speeder left the Senate Building, a [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|member]] of Death Watch detonated an explosive in the speeder, disabling one of its [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and deactivating its [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]].<ref name="dom" />

Aramis began lose control of the airspeeder, which started to fall from the airlanes. Managing to steer the speeder towards a nearby balcony, Aramis ordered the Duchess and her guards to jump out of the speeder to safety while the pilot kept the ship somewhat stable. Kryze, reluctant to jump and leave Aramis in the damaged speeder, tried to protest, but her three guards forced her out of the descending ship and onto the balcony. With his four passengers safe, Aramis lost complete control of his ship, and the speeder crashed into a building, killing the pilot.<ref name="dom" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Get her out of here.|Aramis ordering the guards to save Kryze's life|<ref name="dom" />}}
Aramis cared about the Duchess Satine, enough that he was willing to sacrifice his life so that she and her guards could jump to safety. Aramis was also a skilled enough pilot that he was able to regain partial control of a heavily damaged airspeeder.<ref name="dom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aramis first appeared in the [[2010]] "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]," the fourteenth episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. In the episode, Aramis was voiced by [[Corey Burton]].
